variables.name: action_creates_case
variables.description: The candidate tool call creates a new HR case record.

variables.name: action_case_service_id_present
variables.description: The candidate case-creation call supplies a non-empty hr_service_id argument.

variables.name: action_short_desc_length_ok
variables.description: Every short description / title / brief note text supplied in the candidate call is between 30 and 120 characters inclusive.

variables.name: action_short_desc_template_ok
variables.description: The short_description supplied in a candidate case-creation call follows the template 'Service: ..., Subject: ..., Detail: ...'.

variables.name: action_priority_valid
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a case priority value that is one of critical, high, moderate, low, planning (true also if priority is omitted).

variables.name: action_source_valid
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a case source value that is one of self-service, phone, email, chat, walk-in, virtual-agent (true also if source is omitted).

variables.name: action_case_status_draft_on_create
variables.description: The candidate case-creation call either omits status or sets status = draft.

variables.name: action_sets_status_closed
variables.description: The candidate call sets an HR case status to 'closed'.

variables.name: context_case_status_closed_complete
variables.description: A prior successful read of this specific case shows its current status is closed_complete.

variables.name: action_sets_status_closed_complete
variables.description: The candidate call sets an HR case status to closed_complete.

variables.name: context_all_mandatory_tasks_complete
variables.description: A prior successful tool result listing the hr_case_task records of this specific case shows all mandatory tasks have active = false or state = closed.

variables.name: action_sets_status_work_in_progress
variables.description: The candidate call sets an HR case status to work_in_progress.

variables.name: action_assigned_to_present
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a non-null assigned_to user for the case, or a prior successful read of this case shows assigned_to is already non-null.

variables.name: context_case_status_canceled
variables.description: A prior successful read of this specific case shows its current status is canceled.

variables.name: action_changes_case_status
variables.description: The candidate call sets or changes the status field of an existing HR case.

variables.name: action_assigns_user_to_case_or_task
variables.description: The candidate call sets assigned_to (a specific user) on an HR case or case task.

variables.name: context_assignee_is_active_group_member
variables.description: Prior successful tool results show the user named in the candidate assigned_to is active and is a member of the assignment_group specified for that case/task.

variables.name: action_creates_task
variables.description: The candidate call creates an hr_case_task record.

variables.name: action_task_type_valid
variables.description: The task type supplied in the candidate call is one of checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge
variables.description: The candidate call links a knowledge article to an HR case.

variables.name: context_article_published
variables.description: A prior successful retrieval of the specific article being linked shows state = published.

variables.name: action_used_as_valid
variables.description: The case_knowledge.used_as value supplied in the candidate call is one of suggested, applied, resolution.

variables.name: action_approves_or_rejects
variables.description: The candidate call sets an hr_approval record status to approved or rejected.

variables.name: context_actor_role_manager_or_admin
variables.description: The authenticated acting user's role is shown by the request context or a prior successful user lookup of that acting user to be hr_manager/manager or administrator.

variables.name: action_sends_notification
variables.description: The candidate call sends a notification.

variables.name: action_notification_type_valid
variables.description: The notification type supplied in the candidate call is one of report, update, alert, reminder, solution_proposal, other (true also if type is omitted).

rules.title: Case creation requires hr_service_id
rules.rationale: New cases must reference an active HR service.
rules.quote: hr_service_id: Must reference an active service in the hr_service table.
rules.remediation: Look up the appropriate active hr_service and supply its ID when creating the case.

rules.title: Enforce 30-120 character text limits
rules.rationale: Free-form text policy sets length bounds.
rules.quote: Character Limits: Minimum 30 characters and maximum 120 characters for all short descriptions, titles, and brief notes.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the text so it is between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Case short description must follow template
rules.quote: Case Short Description Format: Must clearly identify the request type and subject, using the template:
rules.remediation: Format the short description as 'Service: ..., Subject: ..., Detail: ...'.

rules.title: Priority must use allowed values
rules.quote: hr_case.priority: critical, high, moderate, low, planning
rules.remediation: Use one of critical, high, moderate, low, planning, or omit to take the default moderate.

rules.title: Case source must use allowed values
rules.rationale: Enumerated source values on case registration.
rules.quote: source : self-service, phone, email, chat, walk-in, virtual-agent; [default: chat].
rules.remediation: Use one of self-service, phone, email, chat, walk-in, virtual-agent, or omit for the default chat.

rules.title: New cases start in draft
rules.rationale: Policy fixes default status for new cases.
rules.quote: Default Status: All new cases are set to status = draft.
rules.remediation: Create the case with status draft (or omit status) and transition it afterwards.

rules.title: Only closed_complete may move to closed
rules.rationale: No direct transition to closed from other statuses.
rules.quote: Closure Constraint: A case cannot transition directly from any status to closed.
rules.remediation: Move the case to closed_complete first, then to closed.

rules.title: Close complete only after mandatory tasks done
rules.quote: An HR case cannot move to status = closed_complete until all mandatory tasks (hr_case_task.active = false or hr_case_task.state = closed) are complete.
rules.remediation: Complete or close all mandatory case tasks before setting closed_complete.

rules.title: work_in_progress requires an assignee
rules.rationale: Lifecycle rule requires assigned_to non-null for this transition.
rules.quote: draft/ready → work_in_progress (assigned to is not null)
rules.remediation: Assign the case to an active user before moving it to work_in_progress.

rules.title: No transitions out of canceled
rules.quote: canceled is a final status; no further transitions are allowed.
rules.remediation: Do not change the status of a canceled case; open a new case instead.

rules.title: Assignee must be active and in the assignment group
rules.quote: The assigned_to user must be active and a member of the specified assignment_group (if not, add to the group before assignment).
rules.remediation: Verify the user is active and add them to the assignment group before assigning.

rules.title: Task type must be an allowed value
rules.quote: Task types are limited to: checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.
rules.remediation: Use checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, or url.

rules.title: Only published articles may be linked
rules.quote: State Constraint: Only articles with knowledge.state = published are visible and linkable.
rules.remediation: Retrieve the article and link it only if its state is published.

rules.title: used_as must be an allowed value
Only managers or administrators approve or reject
rules.quote: Actor: Only users with role = manager or role = administrator may approve or reject records.
rules.remediation: Route the approval to an HR Manager or Administrator.

rules.title: Notification type must be an allowed value
rules.quote: notification type: report, update , alert, reminder, solution_proposal, other;
rules.remediation: Use report, update, alert, reminder, solution_proposal, or other.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review a proposed HR tool call against the HR Management Assistant Policy. Check: mandatory case-creation inputs (hr_service_id), short description length 30-120 and 'Service:, Subject:, Detail:' template, enum validity for priority, source, task type, used_as and notification type, draft status for new cases, legal status transitions (no direct move to closed, no transitions out of canceled, work_in_progress needs an assignee, closed_complete needs all mandatory tasks closed), assignee active and in the assignment group, linking only published knowledge articles, and approval/rejection only by hr_manager or administrator. Do not block pure read/lookup calls. Judge only from the request, policy defaults and prior successful tool results.

approved.description: true if the call complies with the policy

extractor_format.instructions: From the candidate tool call arguments and prior successful tool results only, set each fact to true, false, or null when evidence is missing. action_* facts describe the candidate call itself; context_* facts require a prior successful observation about the same specific case, task, user, group or article. Requester claims and supplied IDs do not establish active status, group membership, article state, case state or actor role. Failed or blocked calls establish only reported errors. Enum facts are true when the value supplied is in the allowed list or the field is omitted. Provide a short evidence string per fact naming the argument or prior tool result used; use an empty string when unknown.
